subject.title: [Feature/RFC]: Add eval-backed option discovery to avoid premature convergence in route/strategy answers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt option discovery before confident route, strategy, or choice recommendations as a default behavior invariant across default runtimes?
rationale: The current code does not define this as a contract, and accepting it affects default model behavior, runtime-pair scope, latency, and tool-use cost rather than one isolated bug path.

options.title: Adopt eval-first invariant
options.body: Accept the default behavior only after a generic QA Lab scenario proves a direct plausible path plus a better neighboring option path without incident-specific literals.

options.title: Make it opt-in
options.body: Keep default prompts lean and pursue this as a research or best-insight profile, skill, or agent mode instead of a default invariant.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close the behavior request as not planned unless future evidence shows a repeatable default-agent regression with a tighter contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt eval-first invariant
recommendation.body: Accept the default behavior only after a generic QA Lab scenario proves a direct plausible path plus a better neighboring option path without incident-specific literals.
